_meta.indication: XDEMVY is indicated for the treatment of Demodex blepharitis.

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in the reviewed documents
pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, controlled, multicenter, double-masked, parallel group study; subjects randomized 1:1 to lotilaner ophthalmic solution or vehicle, instilled twice daily in each eye for 43 days (~6 weeks).
pivotal_trials.population: Adults (>= 18 years) with Demodex blepharitis: >10 lashes with collarettes on the upper eyelid (collarette score >= 2), at least mild eyelid margin erythema, and Demodex density >= 1.5 mites per lash.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of subjects cured based on a collarette score of 0 for the upper eyelid of the analysis eye at Day 43.
pivotal_trials.result: Collarette cure at Day 43: 44% lotilaner vs 7% vehicle; difference 0.3669; p < 0.0001.

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in the reviewed documents
pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-masked, vehicle-controlled study with identical inclusion/exclusion criteria, efficacy assessments, randomized study drugs and treatment duration as TRS-009.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with Demodex blepharitis; identical inclusion/exclusion criteria as Saturn-1.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of subjects cured based on a collarette score of 0 for the upper eyelid of the analysis eye at Day 43.
pivotal_trials.result: Collarette cure at Day 43: 55% lotilaner vs 12% vehicle; difference 0.4250; p < 0.0001.

key_safety: Most common ocular adverse reaction was instillation site stinging and burning (10%); other ocular reactions reported in <2% of patients were chalazion/hordeolum and punctate keratitis. Evaluated in 833 patients across Saturn-1 and Saturn-2; no deaths occurred.
target_moa: Lotilaner is an isoxazoline ectoparasiticide that inhibits mite GABA-gated chloride channels, blocking chloride ion transfer across cell membranes and causing uncontrolled neuromuscular activity and spastic paralysis of Demodex mites.
modality: Small molecule (isoxazoline ectoparasiticide, lotilaner ophthalmic solution 0.25%)

advisory_committee.vote: Application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because it did not raise significant public health questions on the role of the drug in the diagnosis or treatment of Demodex blepharitis.

basis.text: Application was designated Standard (S), not priority review.
